blogSub: Guides to mining Blocknet on bntpool.com.
blogMetaTitle: Blocknet mining pool guides · bntpool.com blog
blogMetaDescription: Guides to mining Blocknet on bntpool.com: getting started, PPLNS payouts, your miner stats, and the Blocknet coin itself.
suggestPrompt: This page is available in English.
calcIntro: Estimate your Blocknet mining rewards in BNT per day and week using live network data, your hashrate and the reward schedule.
calcError: Live data is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
calcStale: These inputs are over five minutes old. Refresh live data to calculate again.
calcEmpty: Enter your hashrate to see an estimate.
calcInvalid: Enter a hashrate from 0 to the network hashrate.
calcAssumptions: Estimates assume continuous mining at the current network hashrate and 288 blocks per day. Scheduled reward changes are included. Pool luck and PPLNS affect when rewards arrive; this is not a payout schedule.
calcNoScript: Enable JavaScript for live estimates, or use the formula below.
calcSource: Your hashrate stays in this browser. Network data comes from bntpool.com.
